info.title: pollen
info.description: Public API for the Tamanu deployment onboarding wizard.

post.summary: Create a new draft, binding the bundled default ruleset or a previewed branch.

Finalise a draft, freezing it against its bound ruleset. Always produces an
artifact; the verdict (including a blocking one) is recorded, not enforced.

Fork a new draft from any application, with lineage to it. `to_default`
rebinds to the bundled default; a named branch rebinds to that previewed
ruleset; otherwise the parent's ruleset is kept. Rebinding migrates the
answers (stable-id set-diff). The parent is left untouched.
Read an application with its current evaluation.
Replace a draft's answers. Rejected (409) once finalised.
Service name and version. Doubles as a trivial reachability check.
Price a plan from its answers (the priced wizard).

Work out the size band, and facility servers, from sizing answers (the
calculator's estimator).

Alternative.description: The headline figures under other answers.

AppView.description:
The full state of an application: its lifecycle fields, the questions to
render, the current answers, the evaluation (consequences, verdict, derived
values, visible questions, guidance), and, on a fork, what changed.

sections.description: The flow's sections, in presentation order.

update_available.description:
True when the plan is bound to a ruleset other than the current bundled
default, meaning a newer default is available. A draft updates in place; a
finalised plan spawns a new draft on the new ruleset.

ApplicationStatus.description: Whether an artifact is still being edited or has been frozen.

Area.description:
One area of a migration. Declared in the order the areas are worked, which
is the order an estimate lists them in.

AreaLine.description: One area in scope, with its figures as displayed.

oneOf.description:
How many of it, for forms and registries: a range when the count was
not answered.

weeks.description: Elapsed weeks, to the nearest half.

group.description: Areas sharing a group are alternatives: at most one is picked.

name.description: The area as an estimate names it.

pick.description:
How the area is offered as a choice. An area without one comes with a
tier or another answer.

weeks.description: Elapsed weeks, for one of it.

Assumed.description: A default the engine applied because the question was left unanswered.

Audience.description: Which reader a consequence is grouped under in the by-audience view.

Basis.description: What an area's starting range rests on.

CaseBand.description:
Roughly how many cases a program has in total, as one of the configured
bands.

CaseBands.description:
The bands a program's rough case numbers are given in: under
`medium_from`, from `medium_from` to `large_over`, and over `large_over`.

CloneMode.description: The clone used to test upgrades.

Confidence.description:
How sure the model's owner is of a parameter's value.
Ordered from most to least certain, so the weakest of several is the maximum.

ConfidenceLevel.description: How much is known about the migration, not how hard it is.

ConsequenceType.description: The "this is worse" axis (spec WIZ, Consequence type).

model_version.description: The version of the model these figures come from.

monthly_usd.description: The unrounded sum of the lines.

CostInput.description: What a deployment is priced from.

band.description: A size band named in the pricing configuration.

central_in_cloud.description:
Whether the central server is in BES cloud. A client-hosted central
server costs BES nothing, though its clone still runs in BES cloud.

clone_uptime.description:
How much of the month a standard clone runs, as a fraction. Omitted
takes the configured share. Ignored unless the clone is standard.

demo_training.description: A demo/training environment for the deployment, on unless declined.

windows_central.description: A Windows central server. Applies only while the central is in BES cloud.

windows_facilities.description: How many of the cloud facility servers run Windows (capped at their count).

confidence.description:
The weakest confidence among the parameters the line rests on, so a
figure made of estimates is not mistaken for a fact.

detail.description: What the line is made of, such as the server and its storage.

config_branch.description: A ruleset branch to preview; omitted binds the bundled default.

DisplayTotal.description:
The displayed figures: margin and currency applied, then each line rounded
to the configured step. The monthly figure is the sum of the rounded lines,
and the annual figure twelve times it, so what is shown adds up.

lines.description: Each line's displayed figure, in the order of the lines.

DocLevel.description:
An answer to one of the documentation questions, and the rating of the four
together.

no_contact.description: If there turns out to be no knowledgeable contact.

flags.description: Each assumption made and each change to the scope.

narrowing.description:
The unanswered questions that move the range, those that move it most
first.

narrows_after.description: Why the range is wide, and when a better estimate can be given.

person_days.description: Data team person-days, with the review allowance.

oneOf.description: M0 and M1 person-days, reported on their own for the smaller tiers.

stop_flags.description: Conditions the Data Lead weighs before the estimate goes further.

oneOf.description:
The tier chosen. When none is, the range runs from the smallest scope
to the largest.

upper_bound.description: The figures are an upper bound (a spreadsheet-only source).

workings.description: Each adjustment applied, and how the timeline is put together.

EstimateInput.description:
The answers a BES-led estimate is worked out from. Every one can be left
out, which reads as unknown.

facility_count.description: Sites going live, each with its own cutover.

oneOf.description:
Years of visit history to migrate, as a band. Only read when visit
history is in scope.

many_users.description:
Whether more staff are to be migrated than `users.many_over`, past
staff included when records are attributed to them.

oneOf.description: Patients seen a day in total across all sites, as a band.

remove.description: Areas taken out of the tier's.

source_instances.description:
Separate copies of the source system, read in bands: one, a few, and
many.

EstimatorQuestion.description: A sizing question as the estimator offers it.

EstimatorView.description: The questions the estimator asks, taken from the ruleset.

assumed.description:
Visible questions left unanswered whose blessed-path default the engine
applied on the user's behalf (spec WIZ, assumed defaults).

consequences.description: Every triggered consequence, in ruleset order.

derived.description: Derived values keyed by derivation id (e.g. `size` → `Medium`).

open_items.description:
Visible questions the user marked unsure, or left blank where an unsure
option was available. These make the artifact interim.

required.description:
Visible questions that must be answered: no default to fall back on and
no unsure option to decline with. These block finalising.

requirements.description:
The compute requirements for the classes present in the deployment, in
ruleset order (spec WIZ, Compute requirements).

visible_questions.description:
The ids of questions currently shown, in ruleset order (spec WIZ,
visibility). The frontend renders exactly these.

FacilityGuess.description: The guessed cloud facility server count and what it rests on.

count.description: Facility servers in BES cloud as answered, before any setting.

total.description:
All the deployment's facility servers, in BES cloud or not: the most a
setting can put in BES cloud.

config_branch.description: A ruleset branch to rebind to; omitted keeps the parent's ruleset.

to_default.description:
Rebind to the current bundled default ruleset (takes precedence over
`config_branch`). Used to update a stale draft to the latest default.

oneOf.description:
Days to build the import templates, when they are not known to exist:
from none when that is not answered.

total_days.description: Data team days for the engagement, to the nearest half.

workings.description: How each project's days are put together.

templates_exist.description: Whether BES import templates already exist for these registries and forms.

ImportProject.description: One program of a client-prepared engagement.

oneOf.description: Roughly how many cases the program has in total.

forms.description: Forms the program's data is imported into.

registry.description: Whether the program has a registry, which brings in its patients.

days.description: Data team days, to the nearest half.

number.description: The project's position in the engagement, from 1.

registry.description: Whether it has a registry; none when not answered.

sites.description: Sites going live; none when not answered.

weeks.description: Elapsed weeks once the formatted data arrives, to the nearest half.

LineId.description: A line of the breakdown. Ids are stable, so tests and the UI can key on them.

MigrationModelView.description: The model's configuration, for the estimator's controls.

case_bands.description: The bands a program's rough case numbers are given in.

installs_some_from.description: Separate installs from which a few, and from which many, add time.

many_users_over.description: Staff to be migrated beyond which users take longer.

max_count.description: The most a count answer is read as.

max_projects.description: The most programs a client-prepared engagement is read as.

patients_bands.description: The bands of total patients a day across all sites.

unsure_tier.description: The tier an estimate starts from when none is chosen.

years_bands.description: The bands of years of visit history to migrate.

MigrationView.description: What a fork's migration changed (spec WIZ, stable-id migration).

Narrowing.description:
An unanswered question, and the range with its cheapest and costliest
answer.

question.description: The question as the form asks it.

OpenLine.description: A cost input resting on an answer still open, priced one way for now.

display_monthly.description: What it adds each month, displayed as the lines of the breakdown are.

included.description: Whether the line is in the figure as it stands.

exclusive.description:
In a multi-select, choosing this option clears the others, and choosing
any other clears this one (e.g. a "none of these" choice).

unsure.description:
This option means "I don't know". Choosing it assumes nothing and
records the question as an open item (spec WIZ, open items).

warn.description:
Shown inline when this option is selected, so the cost of leaving the
blessed path lands at the point of choice.

answers.description: Answers keyed by question id; each value is an option id or a list of them.

missing.description: Why there is no figure, when there is none.

size.description: The derived size band, if the plan is sized.

PlanOverrides.description: What the person pricing sets beside the plan. Never stored with it.

PricingModelView.description: The model's configuration, for the calculator's controls.

estimator.description: The sizing questions the calculator's estimator asks.

facility_guess_by_band.description:
For each band, in order, the facility servers if they all run in BES
cloud.

facility_slider_question.description: The wizard question the cloud facility slider takes the place of.

mix_share.description: The share of the facility servers in BES cloud for a mix of both.

ProblemDetailsSchema.description:
Wire-shape mirror of [`problem_details::ProblemDetails`] for OpenAPI.

Every error response serializes to this RFC 7807 shape via [`AppError`]'s
`IntoResponse`. This struct exists so OpenAPI specs can reference a concrete
schema; nothing constructs values of it at runtime.

detail.description: Human-readable explanation specific to this occurrence.

status.description: HTTP status code generated by the origin server.

title.description: Short human-readable summary of the problem.

type.description: A URI reference identifying the problem type.

QuestionView.description:
A question's render metadata (the engine decides visibility; see
`Evaluation::visible_questions`).

default.description: The option assumed when this is left blank, if any.

Section.description: A named group of questions, presented together.

collapsed.description: Collapsed on arrival, for sections a non-technical user can skip.

ServerBox.description:
One server: its instance, hourly rate, storage, and how many copies of that
storage its snapshots hold.

db_gb.description: The database size estimated from the band (not an input). Only bands have one.

answers.description: Option ids keyed by sizing question id. Questions left out are unanswered.

band.description: The derived band; none until a sizing question is answered.

cloud_facilities.description:
Facility servers in BES cloud if they all run there, once the facilities
question is answered.

Span.description: A low and a high end.

Spec.description:
One row of a compute requirement as presented: the engine has already
resolved the size band and dropped the rows whose condition does not hold.

StaffingRow.description: The timeline for a number of data people.

as_answered.description: Whether this is the staffing that was answered, or assumed.

people.description: The data people; none when the timeline is the same for any staffing.

Tier.description: The starting scope of a BES-led migration.

TriggeredRequirement.description:
A compute requirement whose class is present in the deployment. Carries the
profile's content (the `when` condition that selected it is not on the wire).

Verdict.description:
The viability verdict: the worst severity present across triggered
consequences. Default-severity consequences don't move it off `Clear`.
